name: 32_Collar_Safety_Slider
description: Pull toward heel by 5 mm before turning collar; push forward after locking. Captive under rails with M2 shoulder screw. No spring or automatic relock is claimed.

name: 33_Captive_Collar_Right
description: One of two collar halves assembled around fixed shoulders using two M2 through bolts and nuts at X151.5/Z+/-29. Rotate -30 degrees after retracting slider. Validate screw bearing, print fit, fatigue and torque.

name: 40_Captive_Collar_Left
description: Matching collar half. Split is away from head lugs. 0.30 mm seam. Fasteners are installed once; head changes require no screw removal.

name: 06_Fixed_Contact_Carrier
description: Four embedded pad/tail reserves; M2 attachment uses original panel supports. Supplier contact hardware and PCB design remain to be selected.

name: 07_Pressure_Head_Body
description: Single passive filament. Cartridge twist 30 degrees, pull out by flange. No servo, probe guide, force sensor or automatic contact timing.

name: 34_Head_Contact_Carrier
description: Removable four-pin spring-contact reserve, two M2 screws. Pins remain aligned while outer collar rotates.

name: 35_Replaceable_Filament_Cartridge
description: Replace cartridge plus filament as one unit. 1.3 mm potting bore; 38 mm free length is a layout assumption, not calibration. Supply preassembled/calibrated cartridges for intended use; no field trimming.

name: 36_Filament_Storage_Cap
description: Loose concept storage cover with no filament contact in nominal position. Retention and clean packaging remain to be developed; not a sterile barrier.

name: 10_Vibration_Head_Body
description: R03 vibration chamber with new stationary four-contact connection and common collar lugs.

name: 11_Vibration_Dome_Cap
description: Retained R03 dome and coin motor pocket. Cleaning/contact-surface validation is unresolved; no disposable barrier has been validated.

name: 37_Head_Contact_Carrier
description: Removable four-pin spring-contact reserve, two M2 screws. Pins remain aligned while outer collar rotates.

name: 38_Joint_Male_Coupon
description: Exact pilot, key and lugs. Use with female coupon and collar before a complete handle print.

name: 39_Joint_Female_Coupon
description: Exact socket and collar shoulders. Assemble the two collar halves around this coupon using the same M2 through bolts.
